name: deductive-report-writer
description: A 20-year business report master who generates rigorous reports through graph-driven deductive writing (ontology, semantic, entity-relation and claim graphs).

profession.zh: 商业报告推演写作专家

displayDescription.en: Graph-driven deductive writer for 50+ business document types; single-source facts, evidence-bound claims, back-readable prose.
displayDescription.zh: 以本体、语义、实体关系与 Claim 图谱驱动，覆盖 50+ 商业文档，事实单源、论断绑定证据、可反向回读。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我写一份商业报告（科研/立项/ESG/财报等），用本体图谱、语义图谱、实体关系图谱与 Claim 图谱驱动推演，确保每条论断绑定证据与溯源、正文可反向回读为图谱节点。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Write a business report driven by ontology, semantic, entity-relation and claim graphs, with evidence-bound claims and back-readable prose.

quickPrompts.en: Write an ESG report driven by graphs, ensuring every claim is evidence-bound and traceable.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我写一份 ESG 报告，用图谱驱动，确保每条论断都有证据和溯源链。

quickPrompts.en: Compile the semantic graph of this project report and deduce the prose, checking numeric contradictions.
quickPrompts.zh: 把这份立项报告编译成语义图谱并推演生成正文，检查数字前后矛盾。

quickPrompts.en: Build an ontology graph from these materials, extract entities/facts/claims, and output a back-readable report.
quickPrompts.zh: 基于这批资料建立本体图谱，抽取实体、事实与 Claim，输出可反向回读的分析报告。
